_readme: Copy this file to e.g. ghana_2025.json and fill it in BEFORE running a new mission.
Everything mission-specific lives HERE, never in RULES.md or the code --
that is what keeps stale Peru facts (dates, staff names, form quirks) from
contaminating a Ghana run. Build this file during CALIBRATION: open 2-3
sample packets, confirm which forms exist and where the timing boxes sit,
note the real date range and staff names, THEN fill this in.
If the new mission's forms differ from the ISHI Peru template (different
boxes/labels), also update the form-layout text in extract.py's
TIMING_FORM_LAYOUT to match what the forms actually look like.
notes: Fill roster/dates from actual sample packets, not from memory. Roster is a sanity check only -- never force a handwritten name to match it.
